About the Velocity X9

The Velocity X9 is our daily road trainer. It uses a nitrogen-infused foam midsole that stays responsive through long easy runs, an engineered mesh upper that drains quickly in monsoon conditions, and a rubber outsole mapped to the wear pattern of Indian tarmac. At 245 grams in a UK 8 it is light enough for tempo work without giving up the cushioning you want at the end of a 20 kilometre run. The 8 millimetre drop suits runners moving across from a traditional trainer. It is not waterproof and it is not a race shoe: for race day look at the Marathon Elite, and for unpaved surfaces look at the Trail Blazer T2.

Frequently asked questions

How does the Velocity X9 fit?

True to size for most runners. If you are between sizes, take the larger size: the toe box is snug at the front.

How long do these shoes last?

Between 600 and 800 kilometres of road running, depending on your weight and surface.

What is the return window?

30 days from delivery, free, on unworn shoes in the original box. See the returns policy.
